presence_definition: Non-null, nonempty string/list/dict. Numeric zero and boolean false count as present. This is not a validity or semantic-equivalence test.
scope: Entire tar member inventory; all CBC EDR JSONL and Sysmon XML records parsed. Other streams traversed but not semantically audited. No extraction into dataset roots. Completed files were reused after an interrupted audit was resumed.
audit_script:
import tarfile,collections,json,time,os,csv
from pathlib import Path
import orjson
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
src=Path('/mnt/SSD_Data/optc/DATASET/ATLASv2/atlasv2.tar.gz')
out=Path('/tmp/atlas_fields_20261024.json')
assert not out.resolve().is_relative_to(src.parent.resolve())
r=json.loads(out.read_text()) if out.exists() else {'archive':str(src),'archive_bytes':src.stat().st_size,'members':[],'cbc':{},'sysmon':{},'label_hits':{},'errors':[]}
prior_elapsed=r.get('elapsed_seconds',0)
r['members']=[]
labels=set()
for p in Path('/mnt/SSD_Data/optc/DATASET/ATLASv2/reapr-ground-truth/atlasv2').rglob('*.labels'):
 for row in csv.DictReader(p.open()): labels.add({k.strip():v.strip() for k,v in row.items()}['process_uuid'])
hits=collections.defaultdict(set,{k:set(v) for k,v in r.get('label_hits',{}).items()})
seenfields=collections.Counter()
start=time.time()
def present(v): return v is not None and v!='' and v!=[] and v!={}
def record(bucket,typ,d):
 s=bucket.get(typ)
 if s is None:
  s={'records':0,'present':collections.Counter(),'keys':collections.Counter(),'values':{},'example':d};bucket[typ]=s
 s['records']+=1
 s['keys'].update(d.keys())
 s['present'].update(k for k,v in d.items() if present(v))
 for k in ('netconn_protocol','netconn_inbound','Protocol','Initiated','action','device_name'):
  if k not in d:continue
  vs=s['values'].setdefault(k,collections.Counter()); val=str(d[k])
  if len(vs)<100 or val in vs:vs[val]+=1
 return s
with tarfile.open(src,'r|gz',bufsize=64*1024) as t:
 for m in t:
  r['members'].append({'name':m.name,'size':m.size})
  if not m.isfile():continue
  print('MEMBER',m.name,m.size,'elapsed',round(time.time()-start),flush=True)
  if '/cbc-edr/' in m.name and m.name.endswith('.jsonl'):
   if m.name in r['cbc']:continue
   bucket={}; n=0
   for line in t.extractfile(m):
    if not line.strip():continue
    try:d=orjson.loads(line)
    except Exception as e:r['errors'].append([m.name,n,str(e)]);continue
    typ=d.get('type','UNKNOWN');record(bucket,typ,d);n+=1
    for k in ('process_guid','childproc_guid','parent_guid'):
     v=d.get(k)
     if v in labels:hits[v].add(m.name+'::'+k)
    if n%500000==0:print('LINES',n,flush=True)
   r['cbc'][m.name]=bucket
   print('CBC_DONE',n, list(bucket),flush=True)
  elif '/sysmon/' in m.name and m.name.endswith('.xml'):
   if m.name in r['sysmon']:continue
   bucket={}
   try:
    for _,e in ET.iterparse(t.extractfile(m),events=('end',)):
     if e.tag.rsplit('}',1)[-1]!='Event':continue
     d={};eid='UNKNOWN'
     for q in e.iter():
      tag=q.tag.rsplit('}',1)[-1]
      if tag=='EventID':eid=q.text or 'UNKNOWN'
      elif tag=='Data':d[q.attrib.get('Name','UNNAMED')]=q.text
      elif tag=='Computer':d['Computer']=q.text
      elif tag=='TimeCreated':d['TimeCreated']=q.attrib.get('SystemTime')
     record(bucket,eid,d);e.clear()
    r['sysmon'][m.name]=bucket
    print('SYSMON_DONE', {k:v['records'] for k,v in bucket.items()},flush=True)
   except Exception as e:r['errors'].append([m.name,str(e)])
  r['label_hits']={k:sorted(v) for k,v in hits.items()};r['labels_total']=len(labels)
  r['elapsed_seconds']=prior_elapsed+time.time()-start
  tmp=out.with_suffix('.tmp');tmp.write_text(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False));os.replace(tmp,out)
r['complete']=True;r['resumed_with_equivalent_faster_counters']=True;r['elapsed_seconds']=prior_elapsed+time.time()-start
out.write_text(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False))
print('COMPLETE',r['elapsed_seconds'],'LABELS',len(hits),len(labels),flush=True)
